jobs.title: New Patient Nurse
jobs.description: If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you. We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives. This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey. It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life. What is the Role? This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants. This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient. If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. If you want to do meaningful clinical work from home and be part of a growing team that is changing how patients access medicine, it is. This is a full-time role, working 40 hours per we

jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. As a talented Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Engineer, you will support the environment, health and safety compliance for different functions and projects across the company. Key Responsibilities / Tasks: Compliance of Health Safety Environment Ensure the organization complies with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and standards set by local, national, and EU agencies. (Mandatory trainings, required documentation towards German governmental agencies) Support the implementation, and maintain comprehensive safety programs and policies aimed at minimizing workplace hazards and ensuring a safe working environment. Conduct regular inspections and audits of facilities, equipment, and processes to ensure ongoing compliance with EHS standards and identify opportunities for improvement. Propose improvements to the system and monitor KPI to ensure a zero accident policy. Assist on proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials and waste, minimizing environmental impact. EHS Management Actively promotes workplace health, safety, and environmental concerns across all tiers of the organization, from executive leadership to operational staff, by ensuring access to relevant training programs and the rollout of EHS awareness campaigns and introductory initiatives. Investigate accidents, incidents, and near-misses to determine root causes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. jobs.title: Head of People Tech, Data & AI
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose Our members' experience in the clinic is delivered by our people, so people systems and people data are core to how Neko runs, not a back-office report. This role brings People technology, people data and the AI tools our People function builds under one leader. You'll own the architecture of how it all fits together: our HRIS, applicant tracking system, a new ticketing system, identity and access, integrations, automation and analytics, across HQ, our clinics and several countries, and how all of it connects to the rest of Neko. You'll lead a small team of HR technology engineers, people data specialists and product builders who already design and ship AI tools and automations used across the company. You'll work very closely with Corporate Engineering, People Operations and Payroll. Your team builds and runs the systems; you decide what good looks like and stay close enough to the work to tell. Most of this is being built now, and the scope grows with every clinic we open. jobs.title: Kundenservice & Manufacturing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Probatix Probatix bietet Labordiagnostik als Service an: Unsere Partner – digitale Gesundheitsprogramme, Telemedizin-Anbieter, Health Apps, Krankenversicherungen und Arztpraxen – bieten ihren Kunden Heimtests unter eigener Marke an. Wir liefern alles dahinter: Testkits, Partnerlabore, Logistik, Plattform und Support. Dabei sind wir selbst Hersteller unserer Testkits. Vom Auftrag über die Konfektionierung und den Versand bis zum Befund im Portal bilden wir den gesamten Prozess ab – in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz, mit Standorten in Berlin und Steinhausen (CH). Als Mitarbeiter Kundenservice & Manufacturing arbeitest du direkt mit unserer Head of Operations zusammen und bist an der Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, Partnern und der Kit-Produktion tätig. Deine Aufgaben Kundenservice Du beantwortest Anfragen von Endkunden und Partnern per Chat und E-Mail – zu Testkits, Probenentnahme, Versand und Ergebnisabruf. Du bearbeitest Ersatzkit-Anfragen, Retouren und Reklamationen und dokumentierst sie nach den Vorgaben unseres Qualitätsmanagements. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme, gibst sie an Produkt- und Operations-Team weiter und hältst Help Center und FAQs aktuell. Manufacturing & Fulfillment Du konfektionierst Testkits nach Arbeitsanweisung – Komponenten, Gebrauchsanweisung, Etiketten, Verpackung – und führst die Chargendokumentation, damit jedes Kit rückverfolgbar ist. Du bereitest die Whitelabel-Verpackung unserer Partner vor und sorgst für den termingerechten Versand. Du pflegst die Lagerbestände in unserem Warenwirtschaftssystem, behältst Mindestbestände im Blick und stößt Nachbestellungen von Material rechtzeitig an. Du arbeitest daran mit, unsere Abläufe in Konfektionierung und Versand zu standardisieren und zu vereinfachen. Dein Profil Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium, z. jobs.title: Manager, Case Management (LCSW/LMFT)
jobs.description: Join the dynamic journey at Vynca , where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs. We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day. At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home. About the job Department: Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Internal Title: ECM Clinical Manager The ECM Clinical Manager is responsible for clinical oversight and management of ECM staff to address the client's medical and behavioral health needs and social determinants of health. The ECM Clinical Manager will communicate directly with ECM staff and occasionally with patients via telephone, telehealth, or during Interdisciplinary Care Team meetings (as needed) to discuss medication management/adherence, ensure appropriate follow-up with Primary Care Provider, Behavioral Health Provider, and other specialist(s). They will guide any crises encountered by ECM staff. The ECM Clinical Manager will collaborate with the client’s broader care team (PCP, BH clinicians, etc.) to provide client advocacy, ensure that the clients receive needed services, and measure progress toward the goals outlined in their patient-centered individualized care plan. The ECM Clinical Manager will monitor team progress and coach staff to succeed and manage performance where needed. This a remote role with up to 25% travel. Candidate must be available to work Monday-Friday 8:30am to 5pm Pacific Time with potential evenings/weekends. About the job We are seeking a dedicated Lead Care Manager (LCM) to join our team. Reporting to the Director of Enhanced Care Management, ECM Clinical Manager, and/or ECM Program Manager, the LCM serves as the primary coordinator for clients, partnering with healthcare providers, specialists, pharmacists, social service agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless, person-centered care. The LCM manages client cases, coordinates health care benefits, provides education and facilitates member access to care in a timely and cost-effective manner. The LCM collaborates and communicates with client’s caregivers/family support persons, other providers and others in the Care Team in order to promote wellness, recovery, independence, resilience, and member empowerment, while ensuring access to appropriate services and maximizing member benefit. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
